messages.content: 你能提供關於電影《全面啟動》的簡介，然後再幫我檢索有關同一部電影《全面啟動》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息，以及電影《黑暗騎士》的導演、演員、獎項等額外訊息嗎？

Then we need to combine results into a response. The user wants a brief about Inception first, then extra info for both movies. So we should call function for Inception brief (no extra_info). Then call function for Inception with extra_info true. Then call function for The Dark Knight with extra_info true. But the function signature only allows title and optional extra_info. We can call it multiple times. We'll do three calls.

We need to output the brief and then the extra info. The function returns any; we need to format nicely. We'll call function for Inception brief: title "全面啟動", extra_info false. Then for Inception extra: title "全面啟動", extra_info true. Then for The Dark Knight: title "黑暗騎士", extra_info true.

We'll produce a single response after all calls. We'll need to store results. We'll do calls sequentially.
